item.title: GitHub Copilot FinOps: From License Management to AI Cost Governance
item.description:
For the past two years, most GitHub Copilot conversations have focused on productivity.

How much faster can developers code?

How many pull requests can be completed?

How much time can engineering teams save?

These are important questions.

But they are no longer the only questions that matter.

With the introduction of AI Credits, usage-based billing, user-level budgets, expanding model choice, agentic workflows, and autonomous development experiences, GitHub Copilot has evolved from a developer productivity tool into something larger: a platform that requires financial governance.

item.title: 🧠 Azure Blob Storage Smart Tier is GA
item.description:
Azure Blob Storage Smart Tier has reached general availability. It is a zero-configuration approach to automatic storage cost optimisation: you enable it once, and Azure manages tier transitions for you based on actual access patterns. No lifecycle rules to author. No guessing at access frequency upfront.

What Smart Tier does

Smart Tier monitors blob access patterns and automatically moves objects between the hot, cool, and cold online access tiers. When data is not accessed for a period of time, it transitions to a cheaper tier. When data is accessed again, Azure immediately moves it back to hot.
